snippet.title: Slumber Realm Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
A dreamy dice roguelike. Enter the Slumber Realm and battle your adolescent fears. Discover powerful synergies, unlock upgrades and equipment, duel broccoli. Decorate your crib with relics of the 90s.

Wishlist on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3325390/Slumber_Realm/

www.SlumberRealmGame.com
